notes.title: FULL VERSION – Update V 1.0.0
notes.content:
Helo! Thanks for playing [b]"Who is the Liar?"[/b]

In this update we have the [b]full version[/b] of the game, improvements and the final part of our dear detective Wadson's investigations!

[b]TIP:[/b]
If you have purchased the game in the [b]Early Access version[/b] and want to experience the new features from the beginning, do the following:
On the [b]"HOME"[/b] screen where is the title [b]"Who`s the Liar?"[/b] hit the [b]"F3"[/b] button on your keyboard. The game will close automatically. When you start the game, your save point will have been deleted, allowing you to start the game from scratch!

[list]
[*] If you want to continue where you left off, you don't have to do anything, just have fun!
[/list]

[b]CONTENTS:[/b]
[list][*] New Case with the end of the story.[/list]
[list][*] New Minigame.[/list]
[list][*] New Achievments.[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gameplay.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Minigames.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Texts.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Puzzles.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Animations.
[/list]

We wish you all lots of fun!
Don't forget to leave a [b]comment[/b] about the game. It always helps us to improve our work :)
